test_DiffusionHybridLoss_forward: test the DiffusionHybridLoss forward pass with prediction, noise, mean, log_variance, x0, xt, and t tensors
test_VLBLoss_forward: test the VLBLoss forward pass with mean, log_variance, x0, xt, and t tensors
test_VLBLoss_approx_standard_normal_cdf: test the VLBLoss approx_standard_normal_cdf method with a random prediction tensor
test_VLBLoss_discretized_gaussian_log_li: test the VLBLoss discretized_gaussian_log_likelihood method with x0, mean, and log_scale tensors
